description.value: Union Bay Market is a convenience store located on the South Island Highway in Union Bay on Vancouver Island, a popular cycling corridor connecting communities along the eastern coast. For touring cyclists riding the Island, it serves as a roadside stop in a small community with limited services. The shop's position on the main highway route makes it a natural waypoint for provisioning.
